camera.title: Camera access
camera.body: civfix uses your camera to capture the civic issue you are reporting. You can also attach an existing photo or video instead.

no_camera.title: No camera found
no_camera.body: This device has no available camera. Attach an existing photo or video instead.

error.photo: Could not take the photo. Try again.
error.recording: Could not record the video. Try again.
error.library: Could not open that photo or video. Try again or choose another.
